notes_for_editor: Only one source describes this emergency lookout: a short Forest Lookouts entry with the county, township and a c.1946 note. The firelookout.com Mount Hood region list and the FFLOS register name only the main Bonney Butte Lookout Site (US 576), not this station. County conflict: the register puts the main site in Wasco County; the Forest Lookouts main-site page and this ELO entry say Hood River County. A human should check the county before publishing. Status, kind, design, staffing and access are not recorded here, so the record stays unknown. Story is about 130 words because the evidence is thin.
